column5: or `#contact-container`. IntersectionObserver only allows a custom `root` when the observed targets are **descendants** of that root. Using `#navbar` as `root` would fail (or be skipped) for those sections.

column1: 1. Observe the three sections with the **viewport** as root (`root: null` / omit `root`). Ancestry doesn’t matter.
2. Update the navbar from the callback (e.g. highlight the matching link).
3. Optionally use `rootMargin` (e.g. negative top/bottom) so “intersecting” means the section is in the band under the fixed nav

column3: so the **last entry in the batch** won — even when `isIntersecting` was `false`. That’s why Contact (or another section) could look selected after load while you’re still at the top.
